subject: FOCUS DECISION V2: continuity display-state renderability qualification
body: WORKSTREAM_STATE=DISCOVERY_COMPLETE; MESSAGE_TYPE=focus-decision; STATE_LANE=FUTURE. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. New platform evidence supersedes the prior liveness focus. TOP=C8 continuity-display-renderability-qualification score=24. GAP=ARCHITECTURE_GAP|PLATFORM_KNOWLEDGE_GAP|TEST_GAP. Current isActive(display) is state != OFF && state != UNKNOWN, so DOZE/DOZE_SUSPEND/VR/ON_SUSPEND all satisfy Fold7CoverReadiness innerActive/coverActive. Android documents DOZE_SUSPEND and ON_SUSPEND as display states where the CPU is not updating the display; DOZE is optimized for system-provided content while non-interactive. DuoShellService.routeReady does not prove app-side Display.STATE_ON. This can make READY overclaim actual renderability and allow COVER_READY_HIDDEN/COVER_VISUAL on a display that cannot accept normal app updates. Independent boundary is only Display.STATE_* qualification before READY; excludes route retry, route CAS, physical-ID cache, post-READY revocation, visual phase, process recovery, terminal handoff and angle/input work. Cheapest decisive action: pure state classifier/readiness model over all documented display states, then minimal source proposal/tests.
